annotations.title: Get alerted when a service breaks

description: For services your agent pays or depends on repeatedly, to learn of problems before the next payment. Needs a paid plan token (Pro: 20 watches, Team: 200; see list_plans). Pass url or id and webhook_url (https). Creates or updates a watch: when the service goes down, recovers, or changes its payTo, network or MCP tools, alalanet POSTs the signed, logged attestation to webhook_url (verify it with get_attestation). If its catalogue removes the service, one listing_removed notice (no attestation) is POSTed and the watch ends. Free callers get an error naming the plans.

id.description: service id from find_service results; give either id or url

url.description: https URL of the x402 endpoint or MCP server to watch (public https only: private, loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused)

webhook_url.description: public https URL that receives alalanet's signed alerts (alalanet's own data, never yours; private, loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused)

name: watch_service
